mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spotify_connections ( member_id, spotify_user_id, access_token, refresh_token, token_expires_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{spotifyUserId}, #{accessToken}, #{refreshToken}, #{tokenExpiresAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE spotify_user_id = VALUES(spotify_user_id), access_token = VALUES(access_token), refresh_token = VALUES(refresh_token), token_expires_at = VALUES(token_expires_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, spotify_user_id, access_token, refresh_token, token_expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM spotify_connections WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
